contractSummary: Create one minimal Cloudflare Pages preview project updated by GitHub Actions for same-repository pull requests. Preserve production as a separate, manually controlled future workflow. Never expose credentials to fork pull requests.
task: Implement and validate the GitHub Actions workflow that installs locked dependencies, runs tests, typecheck and build, then deploys the static output to the stable course-homework-preview Pages project.
sanitizedDiff: See .tc-flow/reviews/T-001.sanitized.diff. The staged diff adds a pull_request and workflow_dispatch action, a same-repository guard, pnpm/Node setup, quality gates, Wrangler Pages deployment, a static workflow validator, and documentation of the preview/production boundary. Secret values and account identifiers are excluded.
evidence: Vitest passed: 3 test files and 8 tests.
The workflow reads CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID only through GitHub Secrets.
The Pages project name is a non-sensitive GitHub Actions Variable.
The deploy job is skipped for fork pull requests by comparing head repository identity with github.repository.
The workflow contains no production trigger, production project name, custom domain mutation, or merge permission.
A local secret and PII scan found no token value, account identifier, email address, or private key in the staged diff.
